IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark wavy hair
stands on a cobblestone street outside a café with
flower boxes. She wears a gray cardigan with a
white collar and a pale gray bow at the neck, with a
black pleated mini skirt and tall black platform
knee-high boots. A black shoulder bag carries
three plush bear charms. Gold drop earrings and a
gold necklace. Her expression is warm, with a soft
smile. Bright, warm daylight, a palette of charcoal,
white, and black. Playful and polished, in the style
of a European street-style photo.
